newsitem.title: USA: FSI International sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: FSI International sees Q3 loss.

text.p: FSI International Inc, which makes capital equipment for the microelectronics industry, said Tuesday it expects a net loss for the third quarter ending May 31 of $0.10 to $0.15 a share.
Sales for the quarter are expected to be $50 million to $53 million. FSI said this would be below expectations due to a customer-requested delay in the shipment of equipment.
In the same period a year earlier, the company said it reported sales of $67.5 million and net income of $0.25 a share.
FSI said the delayed shipment of equipment represents about $6 million in sles. The equipment is expected to ship as soon as the customer has secured necessary funding, it said.
FSI said it may not be able to recognize this sale in the future if the customer cannot resolve the funding issues.

"While we are disappointed that we will not meet third quarter expectations due to the push-out in the delivery of this equipment, we are encouraged by the improved order activity we are seeing," Joel Elftmann, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "We believe that the third quarter will be the low point for sales in fiscal 1997 and expect an improvement in sales in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, ending August 30."
